description: Verifies the startup path: the initial camera pose, the resolution of the built-in startup scenario and the fallback rules for empty, missing and valid configurations, the load through the command queue, and the preservation of the scenario and of its camera pose across a view reset, a full reset and a failed load.

checks.label: initial camera: the camera is at (-5, 37, -7)
initial camera: the camera attitude is pitch 0, yaw 130, roll 0
the initial spherical radius is synchronized with the position
no scenario path exists before the startup load
the built-in startup scenario is reachable
the portable path of the built-in scenario is the canonical one
an empty configuration falls back to the built-in scenario
a missing configuration falls back to the built-in scenario
a valid configuration is kept as configured
the load command is accepted by the queue
the startup scenario loads successfully
the active scenario name matches the startup scenario
the active scenario path matches the startup scenario
camera after the startup load: the camera is at (-5, 37, -7)
camera after the startup load: the camera attitude is pitch 0, yaw 130, roll 0
the camera reset command is accepted
camera after the view reset: the camera is at (-5, 37, -7)
camera after the view reset: the camera attitude is pitch 0, yaw 130, roll 0
the reset command is accepted
the reset restores the scenario parameters
the reset keeps the active scenario
the reset pauses the scheduler
camera after the full reset: the camera is at (-5, 37, -7)
camera after the full reset: the camera attitude is pitch 0, yaw 130, roll 0
loading a missing scenario fails
a failed load keeps the active scenario
